programs.name: psimage
programs.purpose: Plot a raw float grid as a PostScript image, optionally with color, a legend, curves, and a second attribute.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: PSIMAGE - PostScript IMAGE plot of a uniformly-sampled function f(x1,x2)

params.name: n1
params.description: Number of samples in the first dimension.

params.name: f1
params.description: First sample coordinate in the first dimension.

params.name: n2
params.default: computed: input file size divided by sizeof(float) and n1
params.description: Second-dimension sample count; must be supplied for a pipe.

params.name: f2
params.description: First sample coordinate in the second dimension.

params.name: perc
params.description: Percentile used when clips are computed.

params.name: clip
params.default: computed: bclip and wclip separately from data percentiles
params.description: Sets initial black and white clips to clip and -clip.

params.name: bclip
params.default: computed: clip if supplied, otherwise bperc percentile of data
params.description: Black clip; legend bounds can restrict it.

params.name: wclip
params.default: computed: -clip if supplied, otherwise wperc percentile of data
params.description: White clip; legend bounds can restrict it.

params.name: brgb
params.description: Black-end RGB color; specifying brgb or wrgb activates RGB color.

params.name: grgb
params.default: computed: componentwise midpoint of brgb and wrgb
params.description: Middle RGB color, read in three-color RGB mode.

params.name: bhls
params.description: Black-end HLS color; read when an HLS endpoint is supplied and RGB mode is not active.

params.name: ghls
params.default: computed: componentwise midpoint of bhls and whls
params.description: Middle HLS color, read in three-color HLS mode.

params.name: bps
params.description: Color bits per pixel, 12 or 24; read only in color mode.

params.name: verbose
params.description: Print clip information; 2 also reports legend limits.

params.name: xbox
params.description: Axes box left offset in inches.

params.name: ybox
params.description: Axes box bottom offset in inches; lnice=1 overrides it to 2.2.

params.name: wbox
params.description: Axes width alias, overridden by width when both are supplied.

params.name: width
params.description: Axes width in inches; lnice=1 overrides it to 5.4.

params.name: hbox
params.description: Axes height alias, overridden by height when both are supplied.

params.name: height
params.description: Axes height in inches; lnice=1 overrides it to 7.2.

params.name: x1beg
params.description: First-axis start, snapped to a sample.

params.name: x1end
params.description: First-axis end, snapped to a sample.

params.name: n1tic
params.description: Ticks per numbered tick on axis 1.

params.name: x2beg
params.description: Second-axis start, snapped to a sample.

params.name: x2end
params.description: Second-axis end, snapped to a sample.

params.name: f2num
params.description: First numbered tick on axis 2; the selfdoc says x2min.

params.name: n2tic
params.description: Ticks per numbered tick on axis 2.

params.name: lnice
params.description: Override selected plot and legend dimensions for a legend layout.

params.name: legendfont
params.description: Parsed but not used in drawing the legend.

params.name: lx
params.default: computed: 0.8 for vertleft, xbox+width+0.1 for vertright, or xbox+(width-lwidth)/2 for horibottom
params.description: Legend x position; lnice=1 overrides it to 8.

params.name: lbeg
params.default: computed: wclip-(bclip-wclip)/20 after clipping to data limits
params.description: Legend start and lower clip constraint.

params.name: lend
params.default: computed: bclip+(bclip-wclip)/20 after clipping to data limits
params.description: Legend end and upper clip constraint.

params.name: lfnum
params.description: Parsed but the legend call uses lbeg instead.

params.name: lntic
params.description: Documented only; the code does not read it and fixes the legend tick count at 1.

params.name: curve
params.description: ASCII files containing curve coordinate pairs.

params.name: npair
params.description: Number of coordinate pairs per curve file; missing values leave allocated counts uninitialized.

params.name: curvecolor
params.description: Curve colors; the last supplied color extends to remaining curves.

params.name: curvewidth
params.description: Curve widths; the last supplied width extends to remaining curves.

params.name: curvedash
params.description: Curve dash indices; the last supplied value extends to remaining curves.

params.name: infile
params.description: Raw float file containing a second attribute in the range 0 to 1.

params.name: bckgr
params.description: Background gray for the second-attribute color mode.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Percentile selection, byte quantization, interpolation, RGB/HLS conversion and mixed float/double expressions affect output. Missing npair values leave curve counts uninitialized. Clip parsing short-circuits: with clip supplied and bclip absent, a supplied wclip may not be read. Legend parameters lfnum and lntic are not used as documented; the second attribute is ignored in the grayscale draw path.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program combines image resampling, color conversions, a legend, optional curves, and a second attribute across substantial conditional state.

test_cases.description: Grayscale image with resampling and a legend.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | sustrip | psimage n1=64 n2=8 d1s=0.5 d2s=0.5 legend=1 lstyle=horibottom verbose=0 > image.ps

test_cases.description: Three-color image with a second attribute.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=64 ntr=8 | sustrip > attr.bin && suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | sustrip | psimage n1=64 n2=8 infile=attr.bin bckgr=0.3 brgb=0,0,1 grgb=1,1,1 wrgb=1,0,0 bps=24 clip=2 verbose=0 > color.ps

programs.name: pslabel
programs.purpose: Produce an EPS text label with a colored background.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: PSLABEL - output PostScript file consisting of a single TEXT string

params.name: t
params.description: Text segment; repeat to mix fonts.

params.name: f
params.description: Font for each repeated text segment.

params.name: nsub
params.description: Character count subtracted when sizing the box.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Font metric calculations and mixed float and double arithmetic determine the EPS bounding box.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program parses text and font parameters and emits a single EPS label.

test_cases.command: pslabel t=Example f=Helvetica size=18 tcolor=blue bcolor=yellow > label.ps
pslabel t='(a) ' f=Times-Bold t=h f=Symbol t='=0.04' f=Helvetica nsub=3 > mixed.ps

programs.name: psmanager
programs.purpose: Wrap a PostScript document with printer page, orientation, tray, and media settings.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: PSMANAGER - printer MANAGER for HP 4MV and HP 5Si Mx Laserjet

params.name: papersize
params.description: Paper size: letter, legal, A4, or tabloid.

params.name: tray
params.description: Printer tray; manual feed forces tray 1.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Floating-point bounding boxes are rounded to integers; page centering uses float arithmetic and truncation.
programs.difficulty_reason: The wrapper buffers and scans PostScript and handles single-page and multipage state and printer settings.

test_cases.description: Wrap a single-page label for A4 landscape and manual transparency feed.
test_cases.command: pslabel t=Example | psmanager papersize=2 orient=1 manual=1 media=1 > managed.ps

test_cases.description: Wrap a multipage movie for tabloid paper.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=8 | sustrip | psmovie n1=32 n2=4 n3=2 verbose=0 | psmanager papersize=3 tray=2 media=3 > movie-managed.ps

programs.license_note: The header says the code was reverse engineered from NeXTStep printer-manager output and references Adobe's PostScript Printer Description File Format Specification.

programs.name: psmerge
programs.purpose: Merge PostScript files into one EPS document with per-file geometric transforms.

params.name: in
params.description: Input PostScript file; repeat for each file.

params.name: origin
params.description: Origin in inches; a missing or non-pair occurrence inherits the preceding file's value.

params.name: scale
params.description: Scale factors; a missing or non-pair occurrence inherits the preceding value.

params.name: rotate
params.description: Rotation in degrees; a missing or non-scalar occurrence inherits the preceding value.

params.name: translate
params.description: Translation in inches; a missing or non-pair occurrence inherits the preceding value.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Bounding-box transforms use float arithmetic and platform sine and cosine, then truncate transformed coordinates to integers. An input without a usable BoundingBox leaves extreme initial output bounds.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program scans multiple files twice and computes transformed bounding boxes for each.

test_cases.description: Merge two labels with separate transforms.
test_cases.command: pslabel t=First > first.ps && pslabel t=Second > second.ps && psmerge in=first.ps in=second.ps translate=0,0 translate=2,1 rotate=30 scale=0.8,1.2 > merged.ps

test_cases.description: Transform a plotted raw float grid.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | sustrip | pswigb n1=64 n2=8 verbose=0 > wiggle.ps && psmerge in=wiggle.ps origin=1,1 scale=0.5,0.5 rotate=-90 translate=1,2 > transformed.ps

programs.name: psmovie
programs.purpose: Plot a three-dimensional raw float grid as a multipage PostScript movie.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: PSMOVIE - PostScript MOVIE plot of a uniformly-sampled function f(x1,x2,x3)

params.name: n2
params.default: computed: input float count divided by n1
params.description: Second-dimension sample count; must be supplied for a pipe.

params.name: n3
params.default: computed: input float count divided by n1 and n2
params.description: Third-dimension sample count; must be supplied for a pipe.

params.name: loopdsp
params.description: Dimension over which frames loop: 1, 2, or 3.

params.name: clip
params.default: computed: bclip and wclip separately from data percentiles
params.description: Sets initial black and white clips to clip and -clip.

params.name: bclip
params.default: computed: clip if supplied, otherwise bperc percentile of data

params.name: wclip
params.default: computed: -clip if supplied, otherwise wperc percentile of data

params.name: xbox
params.description: Axes box left offset in inches.

params.name: ybox
params.description: Axes box bottom offset in inches.

params.name: n1tic
params.description: Ticks per numbered tick on axis 1.

params.name: f2num
params.description: First numbered tick on axis 2; the selfdoc says x2min.

params.name: n2tic
params.description: Ticks per numbered tick on axis 2.

params.name: title2
params.description: Frame title prefix; when supplied, the frame coordinate is appended.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Percentile selection, float-to-byte quantization and byte interpolation affect output. Clip parsing short-circuits and can skip a supplied wclip when clip is present and bclip is absent. Long title2 strings can overflow fixed 80-byte buffers; invalid loopdsp leaves displayed dimensions zero.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program buffers and transposes a 3-D grid and resamples each displayed frame.

test_cases.description: Frames over the third dimension with resampling.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | sustrip | psmovie n1=64 n2=4 n3=2 d1s=0.5 title2=Frame verbose=0 > movie.ps

test_cases.description: Transpose frames over the second dimension.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=32 ntr=8 | sustrip | psmovie n1=32 n2=4 n3=2 loopdsp=2 clip=2 style=normal grid1=dot verbose=0 > transposed.ps

programs.name: pswigb
programs.purpose: Render a raw float grid as a bitmap wiggle-trace PostScript plot.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: PSWIGB - PostScript WIGgle-trace plot of f(x1,x2) via Bitmap

params.name: n2
params.default: computed: number of x2 values, otherwise input float count divided by n1
params.description: Trace count; must be supplied for a pipe unless x2 is supplied.

params.name: d2
params.description: Trace spacing when x2 is absent.

params.name: f2
params.description: First trace coordinate when x2 is absent.

params.name: bias
params.description: Value subtracted from samples before clipping.

params.name: clip
params.default: computed: perc percentile of absolute bias-adjusted samples

params.name: wt
params.description: Wiggle-trace flag; va values of at least 2 override it.

params.name: nbpi
params.description: Bitmap resolution in bits per inch.

params.name: xbox
params.description: Axes box left offset in inches.

params.name: ybox
params.description: Axes box bottom offset in inches.

params.name: n1tic
params.description: Ticks per numbered tick on axis 1.

params.name: f2num
params.description: First numbered tick on axis 2; the selfdoc says x2min.

params.name: n2tic
params.description: Ticks per numbered tick on axis 2.

params.name: curve
params.description: ASCII files containing curve coordinate pairs.

params.name: npair
params.description: Number of pairs per curve file; missing values leave allocated counts uninitialized.

params.name: curvecolor
params.description: Curve colors; the last supplied value extends to remaining curves.

params.name: curvewidth
params.description: Curve widths; the last supplied value extends to remaining curves.

params.name: curvedash
params.description: Curve dash indices; the last supplied value extends to remaining curves.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Percentile selection, coordinate rounding, rasterization and optional sinc interpolation affect bitmap bits; byte bit order depends on CWPENDIAN. Missing npair values leave curve counts uninitialized.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program buffers the grid, selects a percentile and rasterizes traces with optional sinc interpolation and curve overlays.

test_cases.description: Wiggle and variable-area plot with custom clipping.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=8 | sustrip | pswigb n1=64 n2=8 clip=2 xcur=0.7 nbpi=36 verbose=0 > wiggle.ps

test_cases.description: Interpolated shaded plot with explicit trace coordinates.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=64 ntr=4 | sustrip | pswigb n1=64 x2=0,1,3,4 interp=1 va=3 style=normal grid2=dash verbose=0 > shaded.ps
